name: forma-landing-kit
description: An original responsive Next.js landing-page template and AI rebranding workflow.

interface.longDescription: Create or adapt a responsive Next.js landing page using an original fictional product example. Includes an interactive note workspace, original geometric illustrations, feature sections, use cases, illustrative pricing, FAQ, a cross-platform scaffolder, and a rebranding skill.
defaultPrompt: Create a landing page for my product using Forma Landing Kit. Adapt the brand, copy, product demo, and assets.

publication.release_notes: Initial original Forma example with responsive sections, interactive notes, geometric illustrations, sample pricing, accessible controls, and cross-platform scaffolding.
